:::{#exm-logically-equivalent}
#### $P \Rightarrow Q$ is logically equivalent to $\neg P \lor Q$

Adding a column for $\neg P \lor Q$
to the [truth table](#def-truth-table) of @exm-truth-table gives:

| $P$ | $Q$ | $\neg P$ | $\neg P \lor Q$ | $P \Rightarrow Q$ |
|:---:|:---:|:--------:|:---------------:|:-----------------:|
| T   | T   | F        | T               | T                 |
| T   | F   | F        | F               | F                 |
| F   | T   | T        | T               | T                 |
| F   | F   | T        | T               | T                 |

The last two columns agree in every row,
so $(P \Rightarrow Q) \equiv (\neg P \lor Q)$.

:::
